description: Host-injected named fault flag. The scenario/event timeline raises this node's named state ('OpenGates', 'EncoderDisconnect', 'SensorRail', ...) and downstream plant nodes read it. Optional multiple outputs for common fault classes. Fault flags are addressed by OUTPUT PORT name, broadcast to all Fault.Point nodes.

outputPorts.name: OpenGates
outputPorts.description: 1 = six-switch open (gate reset / power cut / PWM gate-off).
